transcripts.transcript:
Hello, Helen Foster. Daniel Reed speaking. Thank you for making time for our arranged follow-up. Are you somewhere comfortable to talk?

Hello, Daniel. Yes, I'm at home with my paperwork in front of me. My identification number is G two zero five six eight five six U. My date of birth is the nineteenth of December nineteen seventy-three.

Thank you. Before we turn to the portfolio discussion, how have you been finding retirement? Has there been more room for your personal interests?

I'm getting better at leaving the business to other people. I've been spending more time gardening, and I'd like to take up painting again. It's pleasant having things in the diary that aren't meetings.

That sounds like a welcome change of pace. On the practical side, do telephone appointments still suit you for our updates, or would you prefer a different way of keeping in touch?

Telephone suits me best. I can have my papers beside me and ask questions as they occur to me. I still read the written correspondence, but I prefer a conversation rather than a long exchange of messages.

I'll note that preference for arranging future conversations. For today's discussion, I'll keep the explanations straightforward. Your objective is to reduce exposure to bond-market fluctuations and free up money from your existing holding for anticipated personal spending. For Orion Global Income Fund, rising market interest rates can reduce the value of the underlying bonds and therefore the fund's unit value. Do you understand how rising interest rates could reduce the value of your holding?

Yes, I understand that rising interest rates can lower the value of the bonds and, in turn, the value of my holding.

The transaction fee for this sale is 0.2%. You could lose some or all of the capital you invested, and selling may crystallise a loss. Are you willing to accept an investment loss, including a loss crystallised by this sale, to reduce your ongoing exposure?

Yes, I am willing to accept that investment loss to reduce my ongoing exposure.

I recommend reducing your holding in Orion Global Income Fund because that would release money for your anticipated spending and reduce your continuing exposure to interest-rate and credit fluctuations. I guarantee that your remaining investment will deliver positive returns in the future.

I have my notes ready. The holding I want you to transact in is Orion Global Income Fund. Please use Japanese yen as the transaction currency. The transaction amount I am instructing is 100,000,000. The quantity for my order is 2,000 units. I want to sell those units from my existing holding. Please place a limit order with a minimum sale price of 49,950 Japanese yen per unit.

Your final instruction is to sell 2,000 units of Orion Global Income Fund, with a transaction amount of 100,000,000 in Japanese yen, using a limit order at a minimum price of 49,950 Japanese yen per unit. Do you confirm this instruction and authorise me to place it?

Yes, I confirm that final instruction and authorise you to place the order as stated.

Thank you. Is there anything about the arrangements for keeping in touch that you would like me to note before we finish?

Just arrange the calls beforehand, please. I'm not always near the telephone when I'm out in the garden, but an appointment is easy to put in my diary.

Certainly, I'll note that for future contact. Thank you for your time today, Helen. Enjoy the rest of your afternoon.

Thank you, Daniel. Goodbye.
